name: Editable Engineering Gantt Items
type: AM Platform / Construction dashboard / Gantt editing

dataIsolation.guard: Every edit uses tenant-locked notionRequest and revalidates the scoped project, Work Items data-source ownership, and Work Item-project relation before patching Notion.

definitionOfDone: Gantt Work Item labels and time bars both open the same edit modal
The modal edits Work Item name, planned start, planned end, and status
Successful edits patch the tenant-local Notion Work Item and append an audit note
The Gantt and space-by-trade matrix refresh after saving
Cross-project and cross-data-source edits are rejected
Same-space duplicate Work Item names are rejected
Syntax, dashboard dry-run, package, and alignment verification pass
Production Render deployment and live modal proof are recorded before status becomes Deployed
